name: Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) program
short_description: The Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) program lets Microsoft partners resell Microsoft cloud services such as Microsoft 365, Azure and Dynamics 365 and manage billing, support and provisioning for their customers, either as direct-bill partners or as indirect resellers through a provider.

evidence.quote: Another for customer management through the Cloud Solution Provider Program.
Today we're talking about the CloudSolution Provider Program, CSP for short.
CSP, Cloud Solution Provider. Es ist das Programm, das festlegt, wie Partner Microsoft Cloud-Dienste verkaufen.
